title: Groupoid of flat coherent families with proper support on algebraic spaces
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], in the universes [def-weil-size-convention], let $X,B$ be algebraic spaces over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space], and let $f:X\to B$. Define the category $\mathcal C_{X/B}$ over $\mathit{Sch}/S$ as follows. An object is an $S$-scheme $T$, a map $b:T\to B$, and a quasi-coherent module $M$ on the sheaf fibre product $X_T=X\times_BT$ [lem-trf-space-fibre-products-etale-covers, def-trf-space-quasi-coherent-module], of finite presentation, flat over $T$, with proper support, in exactly the module and support conventions of [def-sfb-space-proper-quot-functor, def-pc-scheme-module-flat-over]. An arrow over $v:T\to T_1$ is a map over $B$ and a tensor-pullback isomorphism $v_X^*M_1\cong M$ [def-trf-space-etale-module-functors]. Identity and composition use the canonical tensor unit and composition comparisons [def-sfb-space-derived-pullback, def-sfb-space-module-tensor-composition]. The projection forgets to $T$. Its fibre over $T$ retains all module isomorphisms and automorphisms; no isomorphism-class quotient is taken.
